findings: Checked, no S1/S2 found. The diff only adds lines (one sentence, the <OperatorExplorer family="bitcount" /> embed and two blank lines), so nothing was removed. The bitcount family exists in src/lib/sv-expression-model.ts with specs countones, onehot, onehot0, isunknown and onehot-guarded, plus the default state 0100. Its model matches IEEE 1800-2023 §20.9: $onehot is $countbits(e,'1)==1, $onehot0 is <=1, $isunknown is $countbits(e,'x,'z)!=0, $countones returns int and the other three return bit. The four table rows (0100, 0110, 01x0, xxxx) give the values the table states, both in the model and by §20.9. The sentence's claim that the counting functions never return X is correct, because their return types are int and bit (§20.9).
